title: Cross-granulation showcase presets over the bright A/B pair

metricComparisons.description: Tension Blend Cloud should produce a busier exported waveform than the sparse Cross Trigger Relay hold on the same A/B pair
Tension Blend Cloud should read as a steadier bed than the peaky Cross Trigger Relay bursts, with materially lower exported dynamic range
Tension Blend Cloud should flatten the burst profile into a less peaky exported segment than Cross Trigger Relay

expectedVideo: Cross Trigger Relay should keep the image restrained while A/B motion still nudges feedback
Tension Blend Cloud should keep the routed Source B branch readable without overwhelming the blend cloud
expectedAudio: Cross Trigger Relay should read as sparse B-driven bursts rather than a constant wash
Tension Blend Cloud should open into a denser steadier bed as A/B tension rises, not necessarily a louder one
Stereo image and density differences should be inspectable in the exported spectrograms
manualChecks: Does Cross Trigger Relay stay pulse-like instead of collapsing into continuous chatter?
Does Tension Blend Cloud become noticeably denser and wider than Cross Trigger Relay on the same source pair?
